scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Noni Babu Medhavi Shiksha Sahayata Yojana
other_conditions: Only the first two children of registered construction workers in Chhattisgarh are eligible
Benefits are disbursed only once per academic year
If a student discontinues studies before completing the program, the beneficiary must reimburse the entire tuition fee to the Board
Students receiving financial assistance from any other source for studying abroad are not eligible
For Class 10th to 12th, a minimum of 75% marks is required
Registration with the board must be done at least 90 days in advance
Top ten students in state level examinations of Class 10th and 12th are eligible for additional incentives
No percentage/grade requirement for undergraduate and postgraduate courses
Professional courses abroad require passing the relevant country’s entry examination
benefits_summary: Provides lump‑sum education assistance ranging from ₹5,000 to ₹12,500 for school to vocational courses, plus up to ₹1 lakh incentive for top ten students, full tuition for higher studies, and up to ₹50 lakh for professional courses abroad.
